_doc: Reference repositories the watcher clones (depth 1) into references/repos/, which is gitignored. They are read for analysis, never built into the product. Analyses feed the index-model improvement step. Every entry states why it is here.

repos.name: tantivy
repos.why: The lexical engine we actually use. Read how TopDocs, the collector and segment search are implemented, and whether block-max/WAND pruning exists in our version.

repos.name: seismic
repos.why: The Seismic benchmark for inference-free learned sparse indexes (block-max WAND based). The closest published design to the weighted activated sparse index we want.

repos.name: pisa
repos.why: A modern IR engine built around WAND/BlockMax-WAND and efficient top-k. The clearest reference for early termination done properly.

repos.name: pyserini
repos.why: Reproducible BM25 and learned-sparse baselines with standard metrics; useful for judging whether our nDCG numbers are sane for the corpus.

repos.name: splade
repos.why: Learned sparse expansion. Relevant to document-side weighting at index time, which is where our pack's entities/topics should become weights.

repos.name: faiss
repos.why: The dense lane is a doc-id vector store; read the HNSW/IVF search-effort parameters before tuning ours.
